description: This Java class implements the ApplicationInfoRepository interface, utilizing a DAO to load ApplicationInfo data from the database and storing it in an in-memory map upon application startup.

classes.name: ApplicationInfoRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ApplicationInfoRepository that loads application info data from the database into an in-memory map on startup, facilitated by Spring's @Component and @PostConstruct annotations.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the repository by loading ApplicationInfo objects from the database into an in-memory map when the application starts.

methods.name: getAppInfoMap
methods.description: Returns the in-memory map of application info data.
